Hero_Desc_Barie:
A librarian who stays cooped up in the Witch Library.
She is tormented by witches who do not handle the books with care.
Does this miserable and pathetic-looking librarian have something up her sleeves?
Album_Wish_Barie: Getting a shop in the heart of the Witch Kingdom.
Album_Barie1: Hearing that there was a large library in the Witch Kingdom, I went to check it out—only to find it strangely empty. There, standing alone among rows of vacant bookshelves, was the librarian, Barie.
Album_Barie2: Barie complained that witches don't return books properly and are incredibly rough with them. Even when books are returned, they're often in such bad condition that they have to be discarded. Barie looked utterly exhausted.
Album_Barie3: From time to time, Barie hauls out a cart loaded with books to let them sunbathe on the surface. Since the Witch Kingdom is underground, this is supposedly necessary to prevent mold from forming. She seemed to begrudgingly follow this rule, but I could tell she hated being out in the bright sunlight.
Album_Barie4: Jade occasionally visits the Witch Kingdom's library to browse books. Though the library is nearly empty, there are sometimes hidden old tomes in its corners. Whenever she sees Barie, her first question is always whether any interesting books have been returned.
Album_Barie5: The Witch Kingdom's library's cleaning supply closet holds a secret—Barie secretly stashes somewhat worn but still usable books there. When I accidentally opened the closet and a pile of books tumbled out, Barie panicked and begged me to keep it a secret.
Album_Barie6: According to Barie, the Witch Kingdom's library has all sorts of books, but she doesn't know what to do with the ones brought in by elves from other worlds. Sometimes, she brings them to me to ask if they're valuable.
Album_Barie7: I heard Barie's dream is to open a small bookstore in a bustling street. Though she originally wanted a spot in the Witch Kingdom's central district, now she says anywhere would be fine. I even overheard her mumbling about buying a small plot of land near the Order.
LoveHero_Barie: Do you want to borrow a book? Huh? Me?
LoveHeroCancel_Barie: Ugh... Even so, please come visit the library often.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Hate1: She freaked out because she once broke her teeth when she popped it in her mouth to stay awake. It's easy to fall asleep when there's no one in the library, she said.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Hate2: She said she doesn't even want to look at it anymore because folks with overdue books always bring it as a gift.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like1: Saying that carrots are essential food for librarians because they're good for the eyes, she carefully wrapped them in paper and nibbled on them.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like2: She gobbled it up enthusiastically, saying it helps her brain to work when she's low on sugar. I guess she doesn't mind the crumbs.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like3: She drank all the soup, saying it felt good to eat something hot after being in the chilly library.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like4: She must've really liked the sweetness of the cream, since she launched into a lecture about how wonderful it was as she ate. To be honest, I didn't understand half of it.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like5: She loved how you can recover from fatigue with it, not to mention that your hands don't get sticky. She wanted to eat a bag of it every day.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like6: She was about to eat it with her hands, but then stopped and used a fork instead. Does she have a compulsion not to get her hands dirty?
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like7: She licked her lips as she ate, saying that sweets are hard to find in the Witch Kingdom. Where do witches get their sugar, then?
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like8: She hummed in excitement, saying this is her favorite among many pick-me-up powders. She looked happy.
Food_ChefNote_Barie_Like9: She looked at the witch-themed candy for a long time before popping it into her mouth. "Will I ever take a liking to a taste like this?" she muttered.

LoveLetter_Barie:
Hello, Master.

I recently acquired a rather rare book during a business trip to the Elf Village. It seems to contain information about your homeland, and I thought of you the moment I saw it.

I believe it is a book you would enjoy, so I am writing to you. Please visit the library when you have time. I have classified it as non-circulating and reserved it for you.

I will be waiting.
LoveCall_Barie:
Oh, hellooo?
I cannot make calls while I am working at the library...
So I called for a moment on my way home.
I finished late again today, but simply looking at all the books on the shelves makes me feel secure.
Perhaps you give me the same feeling, Master?
Just seeing you faithfully remain at your post as the Master seems to put my heart at ease.

But knowledge only grows when a book is actually read.
So now, instead of merely watching you from afar...
I find myself wanting to learn much more about you.
Perhaps these are my true feelings, kept closed like a book until now...?
If you are curious about me too, Master, you may open me up and read as much as you like.
Th-Then, may I call you again tomorrow? I should go home and try to sleep nooow.
